'''Firus''' is a merchant working for the [[Montelli Family]], found in {{Location|Whisperwind Haven|nocat=1}}. He can be seen standing next to [[Marcello]].

==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Marcello:''' Firus Ferrini, your actions have brought shame upon your family.
:'''Marcello:''' Within a week, all of Ragunna will mock the Montellis for entrusting the trade routes to a coward.
:'''Firus:''' Please forgive me, Signor Marcello, I beg of you—
:'''Firus:''' I'm just a humble merchant, and my daughter is waiting for me at home... I...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Firus:''' By the Sentinel... What should I do to find the goods? If I don't recover them soon, Signor Marcello will surely "settle the accounts" with me...
:'''Firus:''' But how could I ever stand a chance against the Mad Knight?
:{{DIcon}} Have you lost anything?
::'''Firus:''' I lost the goods Signor Marcello entrusted to me, and it's all because of that Mad Knight... What kind of knight attacks a merchant caravan anyway?
:{{DIcon}} How will you know if you don't try?
::'''Firus:''' Surely you jest—one wrong move and I'm toast!
----
;(After fighting the Mad Knight)
:'''Firus:''' Sentinel above, I truly wish to know which noble hero drove away the Mad Knight. Now all the lost goods have been recovered!
:{{DIcon}} ...
::'''Firus:''' The Mad Knight didn't damage the goods at all... Could it be that he wasn't after credits?
:{{DIcon}} I am the one!
::'''Firus:''' Praise you! Without your help, I would have been forced into that labor contract...
:{{DIcon}} Maybe just a knight passing by.
::'''Firus:''' A knight! Could it be... that the legendary knight truly resides here in Egla Town?
{{Dialogue End}}
